title: My Love
desc: Raj, a man from a wealthy family, decides if he should marry the daughter of his father's best friend or follows the path of his true love.

title: Dil Hai Betab
desc: A middle-class girl falls in love with her college friend, and the couple wish to marry, then her father says that he has received a marriage proposal for her from a rich man that they cannot refuse.

title: Waqt
desc: An earthquake tears a businessman's family apart. Years later, they reunite in a courtroom trial where the father meets his sons under unprecedented circumstances.

title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.
